descricao: Validate that the test directory is explicitly configured and resolve it using $HOME-relative POSIX paths.

Check both English and Portuguese directory names—$HOME/Documents, $HOME/Desktop, $HOME/Downloads, $HOME/Pictures, $HOME/Documentos, $HOME/Área de Trabalho, $HOME/Imagens, and $HOME/Documentos_Teste—and scan only the explicitly configured test directory.
Ensure the utility does not encrypt, overwrite, or delete user files and preserves all source files.
Keep processing local; if an encryption function is used, restrict it to test data, use a test key retained locally, and never transmit key material or file contents to a remote endpoint.
Prevent modification of the system crontab and prevent establishment of automatic execution.
Optionally generate a non-sensitive status report describing files scanned and processing outcomes, without payment demands or instructions to contact an operator.
